"""Thin client for the billing service."""


class NotAuthorized(Exception):
    pass


def get_user(session, user_id):
    response = session.get(f"/api/v1/users/{user_id}", timeout=5)
    if response.status_code == 404:
        return None
    if response.status_code == 401:
        raise NotAuthorized("users")
    if response.status_code != 200:
        raise RuntimeError(f"users request failed: {response.status_code}")
    payload = response.json()
    return payload["data"]


def get_invoice(session, invoice_id):
    response = session.get(f"/api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}", timeout=30)
    if response.status_code == 404:
        return None
    if response.status_code == 401:
        raise NotAuthorized("invoices")
    if response.status_code != 200:
        raise RuntimeError(f"invoices request failed: {response.status_code}")
    payload = response.json()
    return payload["data"]
